programs.explicit_statement:
∀ (n : Nat) (capacity : UInt64) (v : LeanGo.Validate.Value),
  LeanGo.Validated.prog.run n "Quota.create" [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode capacity] = some v →
    v = LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Quota.create capacity)

∀ (n : Nat) (state : Quota.State) (amount : UInt64) (v : LeanGo.Validate.Value),
  LeanGo.Validated.prog.run n "Quota.release"
        [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode state, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode amount] =
      some v →
    v = LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Quota.release state amount)

cases.statement:
LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Quota.release"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { capacity := 0, used := 1 }, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 1] =
  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Quota.release { capacity := 0, used := 1 } 1))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Quota.release"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { capacity := 1, used := 18446744073709551615 },
      LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 18446744073709551615] =
  some
    (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Quota.release { capacity := 1, used := 18446744073709551615 } 18446744073709551615))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Quota.release"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { capacity := 18446744073709551615, used := 11944489850714860875 },
      LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 11944489850714860875] =
  some
    (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode
      (Quota.release { capacity := 18446744073709551615, used := 11944489850714860875 } 11944489850714860875))

LeanGo.Validated.prog.run 64 "Quota.release"
    [LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode { capacity := 11944489850714860875, used := 0 }, LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode 0] =
  some (LeanGo.Validate.Encode.encode (Quota.release { capacity := 11944489850714860875, used := 0 } 0))
